description: Bajor's political instability, the Maquis and Cardassian tensions broaden the station's conflicts, culminating in first contact with the Dominion and its Jem'Hadar soldiers.

s02e01.description: Kira and O'Brien rescue legendary Bajoran resistance fighter Li Nalas as the extremist Circle movement gains influence on Bajor.

s02e02.description: Kira is removed from DS9 while Sisko and Odo uncover the forces arming the Circle and pushing Bajor toward a coup.

s02e03.description: The Circle moves to seize DS9, leaving Sisko's skeleton crew to hold the station while Kira races evidence to Bajor's government.

s02e04.description: Mercenaries exploit a plasma storm to seize DS9 so an unjoined Trill can steal the Dax symbiont from Jadzia.

s02e05.description: A Cardassian child raised by Bajorans becomes the focus of a political and family dispute reaching back to the Occupation.

s02e06.description: Bashir grows close to a visiting officer adapted to low gravity while Quark's past business dealings bring a dangerous creditor to DS9.

s02e07.description: Quark leads Ferengi trade negotiations in the Gamma Quadrant with an unusually capable assistant hiding a forbidden identity.

s02e08.description: An attempt on Quark's life forces Odo to reopen the first murder he investigated under Cardassian rule, with Kira again among the suspects.

s02e09.description: On the anniversary of Jennifer's death, Sisko meets a mysterious woman connected to an ambitious scientist's dangerous project.

s02e10.description: Gamma Quadrant refugees believe Bajor is their promised homeland, creating a clash between prophecy, compassion and Bajor's fragile resources.

s02e11.description: A charming con artist opens a casino opposite Quark's while a strange device begins warping probability across the station.

s02e12.description: Odo's former mentor brings evidence of shape-shifting life from the Gamma Quadrant just as unexplained attacks begin aboard DS9.

s02e13.description: O'Brien and Bashir help former enemies destroy biological weapons, only to become targets when both governments decide to erase all remaining knowledge.

s02e14.description: O'Brien returns from a mission to find his family and colleagues behaving strangely, leading him to suspect a conspiracy centered on himself.

s02e15.description: Sisko and O'Brien are stranded in a colony that rejects technology and discover the community's austere philosophy was not entirely voluntary.

s02e16.description: Odo and Dax investigate disappearances in a Gamma Quadrant village while Jake begins work under O'Brien back on the station.

s02e17.description: Dax mentors a young Trill candidate while a rapidly expanding protouniverse threatens both its own inhabitants and the Bajoran system.

s02e18.description: Quark's former Cardassian lover arrives as a political dissident, forcing him to choose between profit, safety and helping her escape.

s02e19.description: Three aging Klingon warriors return to honor an old promise made with Curzon Dax and invite Jadzia on a mission of vengeance.

s02e20.description: A Cardassian freighter explodes near DS9, exposing escalating violence between Cardassians and Federation colonists in the Demilitarized Zone.

s02e21.description: Sisko races to rescue Dukat and stop the Maquis from triggering open war between the Federation and Cardassia.

s02e22.description: A failing implant leaves Garak in agony, forcing Bashir to unravel the tailor's addiction and one of his most closely guarded secrets.

s02e23.description: Kira and Bashir are thrown into the mirror universe, where humans are enslaved and Kira meets a dangerously different version of herself.

s02e24.description: Evidence that Vedek Bareil collaborated with Cardassians threatens both his candidacy for Kai and Kira's faith in him.

s02e25.description: O'Brien is arrested by Cardassians and placed in a judicial system where guilt is predetermined and the trial merely explains the verdict.

s02e26.description: A Gamma Quadrant camping trip becomes first contact with the Dominion's lethal Jem'Hadar soldiers and a warning about the wormhole.
